# Loci live repair and two binding measurements — 15 September 2026

> **Source type:** reviewed repository evidence and session synthesis
> **Fetched:** 2026-09-15
> **Do not edit this file. Edit the derived wiki page instead.**

After Vik restarted, the actual normal Loci host delivered the repaired options and explicit-pair binding proof at 16,091 and 16,019 native-envelope bytes. Browser forward/reverse and barrel proof, renderer forward/reverse proof, exact file identity and two-page binding-file hydration passed. All seven successful original native responses were uniquely full_exact; every source hash/span/locator and byte account validated. The first request's missing temporary source error remains unproven. The source was restored from the exact original Anvil commit, with all638 hashes and no extras verified; historical archive bytes remain unavailable. This closes the old restart limitation. Implementation4a27a8e and live acceptance/pre-outcome freeze dbf1c96 are published.

Vik explicitly selected “Two binding tasks first (recommended).” Exactly two fresh Terra/high, fork-none first attempts ran under the original questions, source and 1.25x per-case cost limit, with no nudges/replacements. Input tokens were391408 and322998; median357203 is1.432835x baseline249298 and47.4% below pre-repair678996.5. Median uncached input41811 is1.131679x baseline. Median visible bytes125908 is1.024713x baseline and elapsed63729.5ms is0.865855x baseline; those two cost gates pass, but total input fails. Both runs used8 provider responses and7 tool rounds. These are descriptive two-sample comparisons including cached input, not dollars or graph-only causal savings.

Only the first agent invoked Loci: two normal retrieves alongside nine shell commands. Its broad question selected the binding type, view type and a planning document; its second query selected the service file. Nine semantic relationships were returned, but neither packet contained the particular repaired CaptureCommandResultOptions -> WorkContextBinding type edge. Both complete native result objects were actually visible inside JSON wrappers. Frozen delivery-v3 missed both because it does not descend into nested wrappers; a separate strict decoded-object adjudication verifies all fields and original byte positions without modifying frozen scores or code. The first wrapper's outer truncation occurred after its complete Loci value. Earlier commentary that neither value was intact was corrected.

The second agent read the Loci skill, then dumped broad tool descriptions. The host reported120493 tokens before truncation; the retained40112-byte output included neither normal Loci tool name. It used eleven shell commands and no Loci MCP/CLI call. This is evidence of unsuccessful discovery, not server unavailability. Both answers identify the accepted full binding and the view's missing required fields; strict compound-fact/extra-claim reviews are retained separately. No claim of all-fact acceptance overrides the failed cost gate or absent expected ordinary type edge. All original45 audit inputs, all new frozen inputs/installed hashes and both638-file task copies remain unchanged.

The two selected attempts are finished with a negative acceptance disposition. W1.8.4.4 and the Objective remain open. The old graph ordering defect is repaired and live; remaining observed gaps concern bounded host discovery, normal natural-language anchor selection and separately versioned nested-wrapper accounting. No larger output budget, further graph expansion, new product repair or additional provider campaign is selected by these findings. The original broader workload still has unresolved answer/cost requirements.

Evidence: /Users/brummerv/loci/docs/reviews/2026-09-15-normal-graph-repair-live-acceptance.md; /Users/brummerv/loci/docs/reviews/2026-09-15-binding-repair-token-result.md; benchmarks/comparisons/ordinary-adoption-repair-binding-v1/{freeze,cost-results,execution-ledger,nested-wrapper-delivery-adjudication,postflight}.json; per-attempt original native observations and semantic reviews. Private raw runtime intervals remain local.
